desc_zh: 两个氢一个氧，最普通的货，也是所有实验的底子。
desc_en: Two hydrogens and one oxygen. The plainest stock on the shelf and the base of every experiment.

desc_zh: 见光就慢悠悠冒泡的一瓶货，消毒洗伤口都行，别沾手。
desc_en: A bottle that bubbles slowly in the light. Fine for cleaning and cuts but keep it off your skin.

desc_zh: 倒进瓶里就看不见的气，汽水和灭火器都问它要。
desc_en: The invisible gas poured off a flask. Soda and extinguishers both come asking.

desc_zh: 无色无味的老阴货，炉子没烧透就来它，通风橱必须开。
desc_en: Colorless and odorless and bad news. It shows up when a fire runs rich so keep the hood on.

desc_zh: 呛人的一股冲味，洗银器和配肥料的都爱收。
desc_en: A sharp choking smell. Silver polishers and fertilizer mixers both buy it.

desc_zh: 烧得最干净的气，也是炸得最痛快的那个。
desc_en: The cleanest burning gas and the one that goes up loudest.

desc_zh: 便宜的酒味溶剂，喝了要命，工业上照收。
desc_en: Cheap liquor-smelling solvent. Drinking it kills and industry buys it here anyway.

desc_zh: 蒸馏出来的正经酒味，消毒配药都缺不了。
desc_en: Proper spirits out of the still. Disinfection and tinctures both need it.

desc_zh: 冲鼻子的酸，腌货和洗垢的老手艺都靠它。
desc_en: A stinging acid. Pickling and descaling both run on it.

desc_zh: 开盖冒白烟的强酸，除锈洗石头一把好手。
desc_en: Strong acid that fumes at the cap. Unbeatable for rust and stone.

desc_zh: 黏稠的强酸，滴在布上就是一个洞，收它要小心。
desc_en: Thick strong acid that burns a hole through cloth. Handle this stock with care.

desc_zh: 黄烟一冒就知道是它，溶银子全靠这口酸。
desc_en: The yellow fumes give it away. Silver dissolves in this one.

desc_zh: 酸得不凶但用途广，洗剂和饲料里都有它。
desc_en: Mild as acids go but widely useful. Cleaners and feed both hide it.

desc_zh: 白色小片遇水发烫，化油污的硬角色。
desc_en: White flakes that heat up in water. A hard hand against grease.

desc_zh: 和烧碱是兄弟，做软皂和电池的都要它。
desc_en: Brother to lye. Soft soap and batteries both ask for it.

desc_zh: 粉笔石头磨成面，便宜量大当压舱货都够格。
desc_en: Chalk and stone ground to powder. Cheap by the sack and good ballast.

desc_zh: 就是盐，厨房和当铺两头跑，永远不愁卖。
desc_en: Plain salt. It moves between kitchen and pawnshop and never goes stale.

desc_zh: 小苏打，发面去味擦柜台，一袋能用半年。
desc_en: Baking soda. Rises dough kills smells and scrubs the counter.

desc_zh: 纯碱化油污快，玻璃器皿泡一晚跟新的一样。
desc_en: Washing soda cuts grease fast. A night in it and the glass looks new.

desc_zh: 蓝得扎眼的结晶，杀藻配染料都有人收。
desc_en: Crystals blue enough to sting the eye. Algae killers and dyes both take it.

desc_zh: 铁锈烧红再冷下来的那层红粉，颜料和磁石都用。
desc_en: The red powder left when rust is fired. Pigment and magnets both use it.

desc_zh: 又硬又白的粉，磨料和坩埚内衬都指着它。
desc_en: Hard white powder. Abrasives and crucible linings lean on it.

desc_zh: 沙子提纯来的货，玻璃和芯片的祖宗。
desc_en: Purified sand. The ancestor of glass and chips.

desc_zh: 那股雷雨后的腥味，消毒猛但呛人。
desc_en: The sharp smell after a storm. A fierce disinfectant and a hard one to breathe.

desc_zh: 白色细粉甜得实在，药店和酒坊都收。
desc_en: Fine white powder with honest sweetness. Drugstores and breweries both buy it.

desc_zh: 正经白糖甜味稳定，柜台常备的硬通货。
desc_en: Proper white sugar. Steady sweetness and hard currency at this counter.

desc_zh: 止疼退烧的老药片，一板能换几顿饭钱。
desc_en: The old pill for pain and fever. One strip covers a few meals.

desc_zh: 白色小粒肥料和药膏里都掺，味不太体面。
desc_en: Little white grains used in fertilizer and ointment. The smell is not respectable.

desc_zh: 清亮得像水却有毒的溶剂，通风橱是它的老搭档。
desc_en: A solvent as clear as water and just as deadly. The fume hood is its old partner.

desc_zh: 稀释油漆的老手，闻久了头晕价钱却稳。
desc_en: The old hand at thinning paint. It makes you dizzy and it still sells.

desc_zh: 一股药水味的晶体，消毒水的老祖宗，碰皮肤要小心。
desc_en: Crystals that smell of hospital. The ancestor of disinfectant so mind your skin.

desc_zh: 洗胶洗指甲一把好手，挥发快得惊人。
desc_en: Great at stripping glue and polish. It evaporates astonishingly fast.

desc_zh: 泡标本的那股刺鼻味，防腐厉害也伤人。
desc_en: The sting that preserves specimens. A strong preservative and a hard one on people.

desc_zh: 甜得能骗人的防冻液底料，收它要锁好柜子。
desc_en: Sweet enough to fool you. The base of antifreeze and it belongs in a locked cabinet.

desc_zh: 漂白水的主料，去渍消毒全能，千万别和酸混。
desc_en: The heart of bleach. Stains and germs both give way so never mix it with acid.

desc_zh: 紫黑小晶体一溶水就紫得发亮，消毒染色都行。
desc_en: Purple-black crystals that glow violet in water. Disinfection and dyeing both.

desc_zh: 见光发黑的贵货，含银量实打实，当铺最爱收。
desc_en: Precious stock that darkens in the light. The silver is real and this shop loves it.

desc_zh: 气囊里的猛料，碰酸就冒毒气，收它得带胆。
desc_en: The violent stuff inside an airbag. It fumes on contact with acid so bring nerve.

desc_zh: 白色粉末，做电池和情绪药都抢着要。
desc_en: White powder. Battery makers and mood pills both fight over it.

desc_zh: 白得晃眼的颜料粉，涂哪哪干净。
desc_en: Pigment powder white enough to blind. Paint it anywhere and it looks clean.

desc_zh: 提神的白色针晶，一撮就够换壶茶。
desc_en: White needles that wake you up. A pinch at this counter trades for a pot of tea.

desc_zh: 黄色片状炸药，模组里最烫手的货，卖它要担风险。
desc_en: Yellow flakes of explosive. The hottest stock here and a risk to sell.

desc_zh: 油状液体一晃就炸，摆上柜台前先想想后果。
desc_en: An oily liquid that goes off at a shake. Think twice before setting it on the counter.

desc_zh: 黏稠发甜的老实货，护肤配药做炸药都参与。
desc_en: Thick sweet honest stuff. Skincare medicine and explosives all invite it.

desc_zh: 熟石灰白粉，刷墙拌灰浆，也能调土壤。
desc_en: Slaked lime. Whitewash and mortar and a hand at fixing soil.

desc_zh: 白色结晶便宜量大，洗涤和造纸的填充料。
desc_en: White crystals cheap by the ton and the filler of detergents and paper.

desc_zh: 白色颗粒肥料兼炸药，柜上最矛盾的一袋货。
desc_en: White prills that are fertilizer and explosive. The most conflicted bag in the shop.

desc_zh: 老式火药的白粉，也常拿去腌肉和作肥料。
desc_en: The white powder of old gunpowder and also of cured meat and fertilizer.

desc_zh: 石膏和白垩的底子，便宜但处处用得上。
desc_en: The base of plaster and chalk. Cheap and needed everywhere.

desc_zh: 白色小针晶，泻盐和浴盐都认它。
desc_en: Little white needles of Epsom salt and bath salt alike.

desc_zh: 二氧化硫，炉子里烧出来的一炉氧化物，陶瓷坊和颜料行都收。当铺里按瓶卖，识货的人自然会给价。
desc_en: Sulfur dioxide - a kiln-fired oxide that potters and pigment dealers both buy. Sold by the bottle and priced by whoever knows it.

desc_zh: 三氧化硫，矿里常见的那种氧化物，磨细了能当颜料卖。标签写清楚，别跟别的瓶搞混。
desc_en: Sulfur trioxide - the stable oxide powder from the ore pile and easy to store and sell. Label it well so it does not get mixed up.

desc_zh: 一氧化二氮，冶炼和玻璃窑里少不了它，收来存着不亏。装在玻璃瓶里，别让它见潮。
desc_en: Dinitrogen monoxide - smelting and glassworks both want a bag of this oxide. Keep it dry and in glass.

desc_zh: 一氧化氮，干燥得很，装瓶就能上柜台。收拾干净了再摆出去，卖相好一点。
desc_en: Nitrogen monoxide - a dry oxide that keeps well on the shelf. Clean it up before it goes on the shelf.
